    CRI-Profile-v2.2

    3916 items in this framework. Each item links to a crosswalk page showing equivalents in other frameworks.

    3916 mapped items reference 52 unique canonical controls (density 75.31x); 18 canonicals appear on more than one item in this framework.

    Why the repetition? AWS maps the same canonical control to multiple framework items by design — maturity-tier frameworks (ACSC Essential Eight) carry the same requirement across every tier, pillar-structured frameworks (Well-Architected) overlap best practices across pillars, and family-structured frameworks (CMMC, NIST 800-171) share controls across access-control, audit, and system-protection domains. Items below with (shared with N items) indicate canonicals AWS maps to more than one place in this framework.
